Our policy says refunds go to the original payment method within **5 business days** of your return reaching our warehouse. Since you paid by instalments, that should mean the refund goes back to that same instalment arrangement. However, I don't have details on how instalment plans are adjusted after a refund (for example, whether it reduces your remaining payments or comes back as a lump sum), so I can't confirm that.

If you returned the pot for change of mind, a flat $6.95 return fee is deducted from the refund unless you're a Leafy Plus member. Would you like me to escalate to a Support Lead to confirm how the instalment refund will be handled?
